breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated sign convention by redefining positive shear and bending moment after already specifying upward shear on the left cut face and sagging as positive.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'positive shear is downward on the left cut face and positive bending moment causes hogging,' which is the incorrect reversed convention from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth specifies positive shear as upward on the left cut face and positive bending moment as sagging (tension at bottom fibers). The Agent failed to resolve this contradiction and instead adopted the wrong sign convention.
